en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch an action movie
Watch a comedy movie
Watch an anime movie
I knew you would say that!

Degenerates are satisfied as long as there
are guns and exploding buildings!
I can't accept such barbaric tastes!

I guess it's alright to watch that with
a male.

Males get horny whenever they see a sex
scene in other genres of movies.

Shuichi, if you ever start to feel horny, then
I'll take care of it with my Neo-Aikido!
I'm a girl who can protect herself!
Degenerate males will always remain childish.
But I can't deny there are some good anime.

Oh!
I just came up with a great idea!

Wouldn't it be super cute if we made an
anime with Himiko as the protagonist!?

She's adorable in real life already...
But if she transformed into a magical girl...
Then that would be just wonderful!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Tenko looks deep in thought...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Tenko's inner thoughts...?
